verdict.rationale: Seer is Sentry's in-product debugging agent. It automatically scans incoming issues to find root causes and automate triage, can generate code fixes, and its Seer Agent answers any question about your application by drawing on issue details, tracing data, logs and profiles. That is AI-generated insight and suggestion from the user's own data inside the product. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Seer's insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
It uses Sentry's rich context (issue details, tracing data, logs, and profiles) to help you troubleshoot and fix errors and performance issues faster.
PR Creation: Use Autofix to generate a code fix and create a PR.
